data.name: Mashhuda
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'Shahada' meaning 'to testify', Mashhuda is a name of great significance in Islamic tradition. It is a name for a woman who bears witness to her faith and the faith of those around her. In the Quran, Allah says, 'Let there arise out of you a group of people inviting to all that is good, enjoining what is right and forbidding what is wrong: They are the ones to attain success.' (3:104)
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes faith, witness, and testament to Allah's greatness and guidance
